diagnosis: Eleven consecutive source workflow runs failed because the exact release manifest no longer matched changed memory, progress, records or assets. The first failure was a stale source-commit binding; later failures included missing tracked files.

separate_site_failure.cause: The progress JSON bytes changed after the approved site manifest was generated.

repair: The read-only source checker reports exact membership and hash mismatches. Its pre-push mode additionally validates a clean closure commit and bound build inputs. CI invokes this mode; PUBLICATION.md requires pushing only the fully reviewed manifest closure.

validation.new_remote_workflow_verification: Pending final source push; not implied by local tests.
